decision: Run Gaia Steward Full as one click in GitHub Actions with any authenticated coding agent (Copilot, Claude, Codex or Pi), executing builder and verifier agents as GitHub Agentic Workflows?
whyItMatters: A single vendor key must not gate the steward. gh-aw is a maintained execution layer that supplies the engine abstraction, supported authentication, sandbox, network allowlist and a safe-output write boundary, so the repo keeps only the deterministic runner and a thin dispatch adapter.
evidence: gh-aw engines: copilot (copilot-requests permission or COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN), claude (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or WIF; subscription OAuth is not supported), codex (OPENAI_API_KEY or CODEX_API_KEY), pi (Copilot auth by default).
Founder directive 2026-10-21: execution is agent-agnostic; no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY assumption; Class B is not claimed operational until an agent actually runs.

The runner stays zero-model and unchanged in its governance: 30 detectors, maxInFlight 2, maxDispatchesPerRun 1, independent verification by a separate agent id, merges into the integration branch only.
recommended: Dispatch 'Gaia Steward Full' with agent=copilot first (no secret needed where the organisation has Copilot billing), then prove a second engine.
alternative: A single vendor CLI driven by an API key in the drive job.
unblocks: One-click unattended Class B on any supported agent.
